description: Zhang Jue, wild chinese mystic in the supplied pixel art style. Long loose black hair with a topknot and a yellow headband, a bright yellow robe with wide sleeves and a white inner robe, dark shoes. He holds a tall gnarled wooden staff with a curled top and a yellow tassel in the right hand
face: Burning intense eyes and a long black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: long loose black hair down the back, the yellow robe, the tall gnarled staff at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the gnarled staff up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, gnarled staff held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the gnarled staff is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and it is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The gnarled staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The gnarled staff stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 the empty LEFT hand draws back; frames 7-8 the left shoulder turns forward, body side-on, and the open left palm pushes straight out; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The gnarled staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Two-handed push. Frames 3-6 both hands gather in front of the chest; frame 7 the left foot steps forward; frame 8 both hands push straight out together; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The gnarled staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Calling down. Frames 1-6 the gnarled staff is raised straight up high above the head and held; frame 7 a step forward; frame 8 the body drops low and it is struck down from above in front; frames 9-12 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The gnarled staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a1: Short forward flick of the . Frames 3-6 it is drawn in to the chest; frames 7-8 it is flicked forward; frames 9-11 hold. Feet stay in place.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 지팡이는 손 위쪽만 뼈대에 넣었다(손~꼭대기). 손 아래 자루는 그림에서 따라온다.
